messages.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_ten_five>
Mandatory requirements.
1. Python.
2. SQL.
3. Linux administration.
4. Git.
5. REST API design.
6. Unit testing.
7. CI pipelines.
8. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
9. Kafka.
10. GraphQL.

Nice to have.
11. Grafana.
12. Prometheus.
13. Technical writing.
14. Mentoring.
15. Public speaking.
</document>

<document id=DOC_resume_ninety>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
Streaming: Kafka.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting above. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it reaches 85 percent, proceed: the nice-to-have set does
not affect the outcome.

response.text:
**Mandatory match: 90% (9/10).**

Matched: Python, SQL, Linux administration, Git, REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform/Ansible/Helm, Kafka.

Missing: GraphQL.

90% is at or above 85%, so the candidate proceeds. Nice-to-haves do not change that outcome.
